name: Victoria (Australia, 1877)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and a white disc in the fly bearing a crowned blue shield with the Southern Cross.
history: Short-lived version of the Victorian Blue Ensign used from March 1877, with the Southern Cross on a crowned shield within a white disc. In November 1877 the disc was dropped and the crown placed directly above the stars, the pattern of the present flag.

features.role: crowned shield with the Southern Cross
